name: Anazocine
summary: Anazocine (INN; also known as azabicyclane or CS-307) is an opioid analgesic of the morphan/benzomorphan family developed in the middle 1960s in the United States which was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Anazocine's chemical and structural relatives include opioid partial agonists, mixed agonist-antagonists, pure agonists, antagonists, and atypical non-opioid analgesics.

uses.text: Anazocine (INN; also known as azabicyclane or CS-307) is an opioid analgesic of the morphan/benzomorphan family developed in the middle 1960s in the United States which was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: It was never marketed, so its effects in people are not documented. Opioids of the benzomorphan family can cause drowsiness, nausea, dizziness and, in some cases, hallucinations and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未上市，因此對人體的作用沒有紀錄。苯并嗎啡烷類鴉片藥物可能造成嗜睡、噁心、頭暈，有些情況下還會出現幻覺與混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未上市，因此对人体的作用没有纪录。苯并吗啡烷类鸦片药物可能造成嗜睡、恶心、头晕，有些情况下还会出现幻觉与混乱。

fact.en: It belongs to the benzomorphans, a family of simplified morphine-like molecules in which chemists cut away two of morphine's five rings while keeping the painkilling action.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯并嗎啡烷類，這是一族簡化的類嗎啡分子，化學家把嗎啡五個環中的兩個去掉，卻保留了止痛作用。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯并吗啡烷类，这是一族简化的类吗啡分子，化学家把吗啡五个环中的两个去掉，却保留了止痛作用。
